name: BoardSight
purpose: Read one annual report and see the year clearly: revenue, net profit, operating cash flow, total assets, total liabilities and net margin for the current and prior year, each with its source line one click away, alongside a strategy-contract view of the price path over the same window so the reported story and what the market paid can be checked side by side.
inputs: Report text pasted from one annual report (income statement and balance sheet rows with both comparative year columns)
Financial year of the report when it is not detectable from the text
Manual figure assignment when a metric row is ambiguous
outputs: Six metric cards with year-over-year deltas
The year at a glance bars

outputDetails.Six metric cards with year-over-year del: Current-year value with prior-year comparison; percentage change only when the prior value is positive, margin change in percentage points; unavailable when no sourced pair exists — never estimated or defaulted.
outputDetails.The year at a glance bars: Current and prior year revenue and net profit on one shared scale, prior year shown as presented in the same report.
outputDetails.What changed ledger: Plain-language increases and decreases for revenue, net profit and operating cash flow computed from workspace figures, with the calculation disclosed.
outputDetails.What the market paid panel: Gross return, net return after a disclosed two-transaction fee approximation, and maximum drawdown computed with the strategy contract on a deterministic sample price series, or on the platform's shared series when capability access is granted. Historical sample only, never a forecast.
outputDetails.Evidence citations for every figure: Each figure carries a tag opening the exact source line with candidate numbers; assignments can be corrected manually and the basis is stated. The fictional example workspace is labelled as fictional.

constraints: Figures without a source stay unavailable; missing or ambiguous values are never estimated
Both years come from the pasted report; prior-year figures are shown as presented there
Historical results only; no forecast, look-ahead or predictive claim
Fee approximation disclosed wherever net return is shown
Self-contained in the platform sandbox; no network, imports or embedded credentials
